picks.title: GenRecs Tokenization: Transforming Ads Recommendation at Meta with Stable Model Vocabulary
picks.rationale: Meta's ad recommender now represents each ad as codes derived from multimodal embeddings instead of a per-item ID, so new and low-engagement ads borrow signal from similar ones. Meta reports a 0.35% conversion lift, which changes how quickly fresh creative can reach delivery.
picks.excerpt: Meta's generative recommenders now represent each ad, product or page as a short sequence of discrete codes derived from multimodal embeddings instead of a per-item ID, so new and low-engagement ads borrow signal from similar items. Paired with GEM and the Adaptive Ranking Model, Meta says it lifted advertiser conversions 0.35% across surfaces.

picks.title: monday.com's Harmony voice AI lifted car broker's deals 9%, client says
picks.rationale: A client reports concrete numbers for a voice-AI sales agent (9% more deals, 70% contact rate, ~200ms replies) running live in four markets. It is sales automation with real results.
picks.excerpt: Sales call agents reply in about 200ms on task-specific models and run on Twilio in four markets. What sits behind the 70% contact rate, and what stays hidden?

picks.title: AI Startup Minerva Built An Agentic CDP, But Don't Call It That
picks.rationale: AI agents take over the customer-data work behind targeting and audience building, turning scattered first-party data into segments marketers can use. It shows where CDPs are heading.
picks.excerpt: Minerva wants to turn fragmented customer data into something marketers can use, with AI agents doing the work behind the scenes.

picks.title: ChatGPT drops to 74.5% of marketers as Claude climbs to 72.3%, Basis finds
picks.rationale: Basis's survey of ad marketers finds 51.1% now run agents but only 6.5% measure AI returns against benchmarks, and Claude has nearly caught ChatGPT. Useful for teams sizing up their own AI stack.
picks.excerpt: Only 6.5% of 184 surveyed marketers measure AI returns against benchmarks, yet 51.1% now run agents. What happens when automation outruns the proof it works?

picks.title: How Australian Home Lender Lendi Measures The Invisible Work Of AI
picks.rationale: A brand-side example of measuring how chatbots drive customer discovery and acquisition. Measurement and attribution in AI channels is still mostly unsolved.
picks.excerpt: Most brands and businesses are trying to figure out how to improve their metrics when it comes to AI – and also what those metrics even are.
